Subject: Request: penetration test report + SIG mapping for SOC2 evidence

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for taking the call last week. As part of our SOC 2 evidence collection, we need a copy of your latest external penetration test report and a short mapping that ties the findings to SIG/CAIQ controls. Our GRC portal requires: 1) the PDF report, 2) a remediation tracker (spreadsheet), and 3) an index mapping file for automated ingestion.

Can you confirm:
- Which report version we should expect?
- Any redactions we should be aware of?
- A target ETA for upload to the portal (NDX-7782)?

If you prefer, you can upload directly to the portal (grc-portal@novusbank.com) and reply here with the confirmation link.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — target evidence cutoff for this sprint is EOD 2027-04-13.

Kind regards,
Laura Chen
Senior DevSecOps, Novus Bank

Hi Laura — thanks for the clear checklist.

Summary / plan:
- Report: "redwood_offsec_report_v3.pdf" (external engagement completed 2027-03-30). No PII in the submitted report; a small number of hostnames are redacted per our NDA with the pen-test vendor. We’ll include a redaction manifest inside the PDF cover page.
- Remediation tracker: we will provide a tracker with status, owner, and ETA for each finding (see attached "remediation_tracker_v2.xlsx").
- Mapping: attached "sig_mapping_table.csv" maps each finding ID -> SIG/CAIQ control references to speed your automated ingestion.

I can upload directly to your portal if you prefer us to push the files. Alternatively, I can send the three files here for you to upload. Which workflow is better for you?

Notes on scope and risk posture: the engagement targeted public-facing services only (ASG and inference endpoints). No on-premise or private customer data stores were in scope. We have completed 7 high/critical findings; 5 are closed with verified remediation, 2 are scheduled (see tracker).

Planned ETA for portal upload if you want us to push: 2027-04-12 by 16:00 PDT.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Cloud Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

- RED-017 (High): misconfiguration in token refresh flow. Mitigation in staging; scheduled prod rollout 2027-04-14. Owner: Nikhil Sharma.
